steps.label: 教学卡与常驻标签断言

params.expr: (() => { const t = document.getElementById('screen-tutorial'); const labels = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-hud-label]')].map(n => n.getAttribute('data-hud-label')); return { tutorialVisible: !!t && !t.classList.contains('hidden'), tutorialOps: [...t.querySelectorAll('.op .name')].map(n => n.textContent), startBtn: !!document.getElementById('btn-tutorial-start'), skipBtn: !!document.getElementById('btn-tutorial-skip'), hudLabels: labels, bubblePresent: !!document.getElementById('bubble'), rematchBtn: !!document.getElementById('btn-rematch'), chargeWrap: !!document.getElementById('charge-wrap') }; })()

steps.label: 回车开始比赛（教学卡开始同语义）
对局态断言（标签常驻/倒计时走）

params.expr: (() => { const s = window.__tsState ? window.__tsState() : null; const labels = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-hud-label]')].map(n => ({ k: n.getAttribute('data-hud-label'), visible: !n.classList.contains('hidden') })); const joy = document.getElementById('joy-tag'); return { state: s && s.state, timeLeft: s && s.timeLeft, playersOnField: s && s.players.length, switchRingCount: s && s.switchRingCount, hudLabelsVisible: labels, joyTagVisible: !!joy && !joy.classList.contains('hidden'), tutorialGone: document.getElementById('screen-tutorial').classList.contains('hidden'), tutorialSeenMarked: (() => { try { return localStorage.getItem('gr-tutorial-seen-v3') === '1'; } catch { return 'unknown'; } })() }; })()

steps.label: 摇杆上推（按上=屏幕上/朝对方球门）
操作后状态（气泡/切换计数/球权）

params.expr: (() => { const s = window.__tsState ? window.__tsState() : null; const bubble = document.getElementById('bubble'); return { state: s && s.state, score: s && s.score, timeLeft: s && s.timeLeft, controlled: s && s.controlled, switchRingCount: s && s.switchRingCount, switchCount: s && s.switchCount, ball: s && s.ball, bubbleVisible: !!bubble && !bubble.classList.contains('hidden'), bubbleText: (document.getElementById('bubble-text') || {}).textContent || null }; })()

steps.label: 收尾读数（时间推进/无异常）

params.expr: (() => { const s = window.__tsState ? window.__tsState() : null; return { state: s && s.state, score: s && s.score, timeLeft: s && s.timeLeft, possessionChanges: s && s.possessionChanges, goals: s && s.goals !== undefined ? s.goals : (s && s.score ? s.score.home + s.score.away : null), switchRingCount: s && s.switchRingCount }; })()
